matchInput: I want to start an online shop
disclaimer: This is a planning outline and cost estimate only. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice. Hire an appropriate licensed professional for compliance matters.

steps.title: Hire a graphic designer for logo and brand identity
steps.why: Online, customers meet your brand through images first. A consistent logo and look builds the trust needed to buy from a page.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for product photos
steps.why: Online buyers can't hold the product, so photo quality carries most of the decision. Shooting after the brand is set keeps the look consistent.

steps.title: Hire a social media manager for Facebook and Instagram
steps.why: Most Myanmar online shops start selling through Facebook. Regular posting and customer replies need a monthly plan.

steps.title: Hire a web developer for a basic online store
steps.why: As orders grow, an e-commerce page takes them in an organised way instead of only through chat.

steps.title: Hire a virtual assistant for orders and inbox
steps.why: Once sales pick up, inbox replies and order tracking take the most time. A VA can own that part of the work.
